ai: He is a distant kinsman of the family, so he was invited to the wedding.
他是這個家族的遠房親戚，所以受邀參加婚禮。
The old farmer left his land to a kinsman who lived nearby.
那位老農夫把土地留給住在附近的一位親戚。
She gave an exasperated sigh when the printer jammed again.
印表機又卡紙時，她氣惱地嘆了口氣。
I was so exasperated by his excuses that I stopped listening.
我被他的藉口惹得很火大，乾脆不聽了。

exasperated.zh: 使惱怒（exasperate 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: The constant delays exasperated everyone on the team.
不斷的延誤讓全隊的人都很惱火。
Her brother's teasing had exasperated her all afternoon.
哥哥的調侃讓她一整個下午都很惱火。
Gunpowder was invented in ancient China.
火藥是古代中國發明的。
The museum has a small barrel of gunpowder from the old fort.
博物館裡有一小桶來自舊堡壘的火藥。
The sprinter crossed the finish line in first place.
那位短跑選手第一個衝過終點線。
A good sprinter needs strong legs and a quick start.
優秀的短跑選手需要強壯的雙腿和迅速的起跑。
The ozone layer is found in the stratosphere.
臭氧層位於平流層。
Jet airplanes sometimes fly in the lower part of the stratosphere.
噴射客機有時會飛在平流層的下層。
The price of that house has gone into the stratosphere.
那棟房子的價格已經高得離譜。
After the hit song, the singer's fame soared into the stratosphere.
那首暢銷歌曲之後，這位歌手的名氣一飛沖天。

beeper.zh: 呼叫器；發出嗶聲的裝置
ai: Doctors used to carry a beeper so the hospital could reach them quickly.
醫生以前會隨身攜帶呼叫器，方便醫院迅速聯絡。
The beeper on his belt went off during dinner.
他腰間的呼叫器在晚餐時響了起來。
The smoke detector has a loud beeper that warns you when the battery is low.
這個煙霧偵測器電量低時，會發出響亮的嗶聲警告你。
A small beeper sounds when the microwave finishes heating.
微波爐加熱完畢時，會發出一聲短短的嗶聲。
Reading is a foundational skill for all school subjects.
閱讀是所有學科的基礎能力。
The course covers foundational ideas in physics before moving on to harder topics.
這門課先講解物理的基本概念，再進入較難的主題。
Residents asked the city for noise abatement near the airport.
居民要求市政府降低機場附近的噪音。
The pain showed no sign of abatement, so he went to see a doctor.
疼痛完全沒有減輕的跡象，所以他去看醫生。
The company received a tax abatement for building the new factory.
這間公司因興建新工廠而獲得稅額減免。
The abatement on the rent lasted for three months.
房租的減免持續了三個月。
Can you give me a quick rundown of what happened at the meeting?
你可以簡單跟我說明一下會議的重點嗎？
The guide gave us a rundown of the day's schedule.
導遊為我們簡要說明了當天的行程。
They lived in a rundown apartment near the station.
他們住在車站附近一間破舊的公寓。
After weeks of overtime, he felt tired and rundown.
連續加班好幾週後，他覺得又累又虛弱。

trying.zh: 嘗試；努力（try 的現在分詞）
ai: I am trying to learn how to cook a few simple dishes.
我正在試著學做幾道簡單的菜。
Stop trying to fix everything by yourself.
別再試著一個人解決所有事情了。
It has been a trying week for the whole family.
對全家人來說，這是難熬的一週。
Waiting for the test results was a trying experience.
等待檢查結果是一段煎熬的經驗。
It was an audacious plan to cross the desert on foot.
徒步橫越沙漠是個大膽的計畫。
The young designer made an audacious move by quitting her job to start a company.
這位年輕設計師辭掉工作去創業，是個大膽的決定。

spying.zh: 當間諜；暗中監視（spy 的現在分詞）
ai: He was caught spying on his neighbors through the window.
他被抓到從窗戶偷偷監視鄰居。
The two countries accused each other of spying.
兩國互相指控對方從事間諜活動。
Spying is illegal in most countries.
間諜活動在大多數國家都是違法的。
The company fired him for industrial spying.
公司因為他從事商業間諜行為而將他解僱。
The student poured water into a glass beaker.
學生把水倒進玻璃燒杯裡。
Heat the liquid in the beaker for two minutes.
把燒杯裡的液體加熱兩分鐘。

galvanized.zh: 鍍鋅；激勵（galvanize 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: The workers galvanized the steel pipes to keep them from rusting.
工人替鋼管鍍鋅，避免生鏽。
The speech galvanized the crowd into action.
那場演說激勵群眾採取行動。
He raised his goblet and made a toast to the bride.
他舉起高腳杯向新娘敬酒。
A silver goblet stood on the table beside the candles.
一只銀製高腳杯放在蠟燭旁的桌上。

germanic.zh: 日耳曼的；日耳曼語族的
ai: English is a Germanic language, like Dutch and German.
英語和荷蘭語、德語一樣，屬於日耳曼語族。
Many Germanic tribes lived in northern Europe long ago.
很久以前，許多日耳曼部落住在北歐。
The navy sent a frigate to protect the merchant ships.
海軍派出一艘護衛艦保護商船。
An old wooden frigate is on display at the harbor.
港口展示著一艘古老的木造帆艦。
The prince ruled the country during the regency.
在攝政期間，由王子統治這個國家。
The king was too young, so a regency was set up to govern for him.
國王年紀太小，所以設立了攝政來代他治理國家。
Sheep grazed on the open wold above the village.
羊群在村莊上方開闊的高地上吃草。
The wind blew hard across the bare wold.
風猛烈地吹過光禿禿的荒野。
Don't be such a wimp; it's only a small shot.
別這麼膽小，只是打一針小針而已。
He felt like a wimp for running away from the dog.
他因為被狗嚇跑而覺得自己很孬。
She held a sheaf of papers under her arm.
她腋下夾著一疊文件。
The farmers tied the wheat into a sheaf.
農夫們把小麥綁成一捆。
Blue litmus paper turns red in acid.
藍色石蕊試紙遇到酸會變紅。
The teacher showed us how to test the liquid with litmus.
老師示範如何用石蕊測試這種液體。
Cheating a sick old man out of his money is despicable.
騙取生病老人的錢是很卑劣的行為。
Everyone agreed that his behavior was despicable.
大家都認為他的行為很可鄙。
Many serious diseases are preventable with simple vaccines.
許多嚴重的疾病只要打簡單的疫苗就能預防。
The accident was preventable if the driver had slowed down.
如果司機有減速，這場事故是可以避免的。
She spoke without any inflection, so it was hard to tell how she felt.
她說話毫無抑揚頓挫，很難看出她的感受。
A rising inflection at the end of a sentence often shows a question.
句尾語調上揚通常表示這是個問句。
The inflection of the verb 'go' in the past tense is 'went'.
動詞 go 的過去式詞形變化是 went。
Learners often find inflection in other languages difficult.
學習者常覺得其他語言的詞形變化很困難。
Many bridges cross the river in the city center.
市中心有許多橋橫跨這條河。
The old stone bridges were rebuilt after the flood.
這些古老的石橋在洪水之後重建了。
Good teachers build bridges between students from different backgrounds.
好老師會在不同背景的學生之間搭起橋樑。
The festival helps build bridges between the two communities.
這場節慶有助於在兩個社區之間搭起橋樑。
She laughed uncontrollably at the funny video.
她看著那段搞笑影片，笑得無法自制。
His hands were shaking uncontrollably from the cold.
他的雙手因為寒冷而不停地顫抖。
She has long auburn hair that shines in the sun.
她有一頭在陽光下閃閃發亮的赤褐色長髮。
The auburn leaves fell slowly from the trees.
赤褐色的葉子從樹上緩緩落下。
Her hair was a deep shade of auburn.
她的頭髮是深赤褐色。
The painter mixed red and brown to make auburn.
畫家把紅色和棕色混在一起調出赤褐色。
Scientists can synthesise this medicine in the laboratory.
科學家可以在實驗室裡合成這種藥物。
Try to synthesise the ideas from all three articles in your essay.
請在你的文章裡綜合這三篇文章的觀點。
Four squared is sixteen.
四的平方是十六。
The area is measured in squared units, such as square meters.
面積是用平方單位來計算的，例如平方公尺。
He wrote his notes on squared paper.
他把筆記寫在方格紙上。
The squared corners of the table were covered with soft cloth.
桌子的方形桌角包著柔軟的布。

maneuvering.zh: 操縱；巧妙移動（maneuver 的現在分詞）
ai: The driver was maneuvering the big truck through the narrow street.
司機正駕駛大卡車小心地穿過狹窄的街道。
She is maneuvering her way into a better position at work.
她正巧妙地運作，想在公司裡取得更好的職位。
The website has a disclaimer saying the advice is not medical advice.
這個網站有一份免責聲明，表示內容不屬於醫療建議。
Read the disclaimer on the box before you use the product.
使用產品前，請先閱讀包裝盒上的免責聲明。

tennyson.zh: （姓氏）英國維多利亞時代詩人阿佛列·丁尼生
ai: Tennyson was a famous English poet of the Victorian age.
丁尼生是維多利亞時代著名的英國詩人。
We read a poem by Tennyson in literature class.
我們在文學課上讀了一首丁尼生的詩。
The eagle caught the fish in its sharp talons.
老鷹用銳利的爪子抓住了那條魚。
An owl's talon is strong enough to hold small animals.
貓頭鷹的爪子強壯到足以抓住小動物。
We met in the main concourse of the train station.
我們在火車站的大廳碰面。
The airport concourse was crowded with travelers.
機場大廳擠滿了旅客。
Deconstruction is a way of reading texts that looks for hidden conflicts in meaning.
解構是一種閱讀文本的方式，會去找出意義中隱藏的矛盾。
Our professor spent a whole class on deconstruction and modern literature.
教授用整堂課談解構與現代文學。
She plays on the intercollegiate basketball team.
她是校際籃球隊的球員。
The intercollegiate contest brings together students from many universities.
這場校際比賽匯集了來自許多大學的學生。
I only heard a snippet of their conversation.
我只聽到他們對話的一小段。
The article starts with a short snippet from a famous speech.
這篇文章以一段著名演說的摘錄開頭。
The complainant told the judge what had happened that night.
原告向法官說明那天晚上發生的事。
The police asked the complainant to sign the report.
警方請投訴人在報告上簽名。

handel.zh: （人名）韓德爾，德裔英國作曲家
ai: Handel was a composer born in Germany who later lived in England.
韓德爾是出生於德國、後來定居英國的作曲家。
The choir sang a piece by Handel at the concert.
合唱團在音樂會上演唱了一首韓德爾的作品。
The Danube flows through several countries in Europe.
多瑙河流經歐洲的好幾個國家。
We took a boat trip along the Danube last summer.
去年夏天我們搭船遊覽了多瑙河。
The book was written in the vernacular so ordinary people could read it.
這本書用日常口語寫成，讓一般人也能讀懂。
She switched to the local vernacular when she talked with the villagers.
她和村民交談時改用當地的方言。
The architect studied the vernacular style of houses in the region.
建築師研究了這個地區的傳統民居風格。
Vernacular languages are often used in daily life, not in formal writing.
本土語言常用於日常生活，而不是正式書寫。
The geologic history of the mountains goes back millions of years.
這些山脈的地質歷史可追溯到數百萬年前。
Scientists study geologic layers to learn about the past.
科學家研究地質層來了解過去。
I was completely clueless about how the machine worked.
我完全不知道這台機器怎麼運作。
He looked clueless when the teacher asked him a question.
老師問他問題時，他一臉茫然。
The market was full of frenetic activity before the holiday.
假期前市場裡一片忙亂的景象。
She worked at a frenetic pace to finish the project.
她以近乎瘋狂的速度趕完這個專案。
Guards walked along the rampart of the old castle.
衛兵沿著古堡的壁壘巡邏。
The soldiers built a high rampart around the camp.
士兵們在營地四周築起高高的防禦土牆。
His eyes were far away, lost in a daydream.
他目光遙遠，沉浸在白日夢裡。
The long meeting gave her time for a pleasant daydream.
冗長的會議讓她有時間做個愉快的白日夢。
Students often daydream during boring lessons.
學生在無聊的課堂上常會發呆做白日夢。
I like to daydream about traveling around the world.
我喜歡幻想環遊世界。
Methamphetamine is a dangerous illegal drug.
甲基安非他命是一種危險的非法毒品。
The police warned the public about the harm of methamphetamine.
警方向民眾警告甲基安非他命的危害。
The coca plant grows in the mountains of South America.
古柯植物生長在南美洲的山區。
People in the Andes have chewed coca leaves for centuries.
安地斯山區的人咀嚼古柯葉已有數百年。
The soldiers were buried in hallowed ground.
這些士兵被安葬在神聖的土地上。
The old stadium is a hallowed place for the club's fans.
這座老球場對球迷來說是神聖的地方。

betrayed.zh: 背叛；出賣（betray 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: He betrayed his friend by telling everyone her secret.
他把朋友的祕密告訴大家，背叛了她。
The soldier was betrayed by someone he trusted.
那名士兵被他信任的人出賣了。
Doctors are studying the degeneration of muscles in older adults.
醫生正在研究老年人肌肉的退化。
The degeneration of the old neighborhood happened slowly over many years.
這個老社區的衰敗是多年來慢慢發生的。
In the story, the executioner waited for the judge's order.
故事裡，行刑者等待法官的命令。
The museum has the old clothing of a medieval executioner.
博物館展示著一件中世紀行刑者的舊服裝。
Nazism caused great suffering in Europe before and during World War II.
納粹主義在第二次世界大戰前後給歐洲帶來巨大的苦難。
Students learn about the rise and fall of Nazism in history class.
學生在歷史課上學習納粹主義的興起與衰亡。

furtive.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的；偷偷摸摸的
ai: He cast a furtive glance at the door before opening the box.
他打開盒子前，偷偷瞄了門一眼。
The boy made a furtive attempt to hide the broken cup.
男孩偷偷摸摸地想把破掉的杯子藏起來。

數千名遊行民眾走過市區，呼籲改善空氣品質。

每位遊行者都拿著一面標語牌和一瓶水。

她在寒冷中坐了一陣子後，手指感到麻木。
The doctor asked if the numbness had spread to his arm.
醫生問他麻木的感覺有沒有擴散到手臂。
On the hot afternoon, everyone moved in a languid way.
在炎熱的午後，每個人的動作都慵懶緩慢。
She gave a languid wave of her hand and went back to her book.
她懶洋洋地揮了揮手，又回頭看書。
She was a kind comforter to her friends in hard times.
在艱難的時候，她是朋友們溫柔的安慰者。
The old man needed a comforter after losing his wife.
老先生失去妻子後，需要有人安慰他。
I pulled the warm comforter up to my chin.
我把溫暖的厚被子拉到下巴。
We bought a new comforter for the winter.
我們為冬天買了一條新的厚被子。

imam.zh: 伊瑪目（伊斯蘭教的宗教領袖）
ai: The imam led the prayers at the mosque on Friday.
伊瑪目在星期五帶領清真寺的禱告。
People in the community often ask the imam for advice.
社區的人常向伊瑪目請教意見。
We were astounded by the size of the old tree.
我們被那棵老樹的大小震懾住了。
She stood astounded when she saw the surprise party.
她看到驚喜派對時，整個人愣住了。

leveraged.zh: 利用；以槓桿方式運用（leverage 的過去式／過去分詞）
ai: The company leveraged its strong brand to enter new markets.
這間公司利用強大的品牌打入新市場。
He leveraged his savings to buy a small shop.
他善用自己的積蓄買下一間小店。
The soldier stopped to reload his rifle.
士兵停下來重新裝填步槍。
In the video game, you have to reload before you can fire again.
在這款電玩遊戲裡，你必須先換彈才能再次開火。
If the page does not open, try to reload it.
如果頁面打不開，試著重新載入。
Please reload the website to see the latest news.
請重新載入網站來看最新消息。
Her specialism is the history of Asian art.
她的專長是亞洲藝術史。
Doctors often choose a specialism after several years of training.
醫生通常在受訓數年後選擇一個專科領域。
The water in the pond looked greenish after the rain.
下雨後，池塘的水看起來有點偏綠。
He wore a greenish jacket that matched the trees.
他穿著一件偏綠色的外套，和樹木很搭。
The movie is about a mobster who tries to leave his old life.
這部電影講的是一名想脫離過去生活的黑道份子。
Police arrested a well-known mobster in the city last year.
去年警方在市內逮捕了一名知名的黑道份子。
The heavy rain turned the field into a quagmire.
大雨把整片田地變成了爛泥潭。
Our car got stuck in the quagmire beside the road.
我們的車陷在路邊的泥沼裡。
The project turned into a legal quagmire that lasted for years.
這個專案陷入了持續多年的法律泥淖。
He found himself in a quagmire of debt.
他發現自己陷入了債務的泥淖。
In the Middle Ages, much of Europe was part of Christendom.
中世紀時，歐洲大部分地區屬於基督教世界。
Historians write about the Church and the rulers of Christendom.
歷史學家書寫教會與基督教世界統治者的歷史。
The news of her resignation came as a bombshell.
她辭職的消息像是投下一顆震撼彈。
The manager dropped a bombshell by announcing the company would close.
經理宣布公司將要關閉，丟出了一個震撼彈。
The barbican guarded the main gate of the castle.
外堡守護著城堡的大門。
Visitors walk through the barbican before entering the old town.
遊客進入古城前，會先穿過防禦碉樓。
Please don't waken the baby; she just fell asleep.
請別吵醒寶寶，她才剛睡著。
The loud thunder wakened me in the middle of the night.
響亮的雷聲在半夜把我吵醒。
He wakened early to catch the first train.
他很早就醒來，趕搭第一班火車。
The village slowly wakens as the sun rises.
太陽升起時，村莊慢慢甦醒過來。
She filled the tumbler with cold water.
她把平底玻璃杯倒滿冰水。
There was a tumbler of orange juice on the table.
桌上有一杯柳橙汁。
The tumbler flipped twice in the air to loud applause.
雜技演員在空中翻了兩圈，贏得熱烈掌聲。
A young tumbler performed in the street show.
一位年輕的雜技演員在街頭表演中登場。

gunpoint.zh: 槍口（at gunpoint：在槍口威脅下）
ai: The bank workers were held at gunpoint during the robbery.
搶案發生時，銀行員工被槍指著控制住。
He said he was forced to sign the paper at gunpoint.
他說自己是在槍口威脅下被迫簽下那份文件的。
The government plans to electrify the railway across the country.
政府計畫把全國的鐵路電氣化。
It took years to electrify the small villages in the mountains.
